title: PCap: Personalized Retrieval-Stage Diversity Capping in Facebook Marketplace
title_zh: PCap：Facebook Marketplace 检索阶段的个性化多样性封顶
abstract_en: We propose a personalized capping framework (PCap) to improve the diversity in Facebook Marketplace by introducing user-level diversity constraints at the retrieval stage. PCap models individual diversity preferences using Shannon entropy-based scoring, segments users into diversity buckets, and applies personalized category caps during multi-source candidate retrieval. To navigate the high-dimensional parameter space of per-bucket caps, we leverage an automated online optimization method called Parameter Tuning Sequence. Large-scale online experiments demonstrate that PCap significantly improves users' browsing experience shown in engagement metrics. This work provides practical insights into integrating personalized diversity into industrial retrieval systems.
abstract_zh: 本文提出个性化封顶框架 PCap，通过在检索阶段引入用户级多样性约束，提升 Facebook Marketplace 的候选内容多样性。PCap 基于 Shannon entropy（香农熵）评分建模用户的个体多样性偏好，将用户划分至不同的多样性分桶，并在多来源候选检索过程中应用个性化类别上限。针对各分桶上限构成的高维参数空间，作者采用名为 Parameter Tuning Sequence 的自动化在线优化方法进行参数搜索。大规模在线实验表明，PCap 能够显著改善用户浏览体验及相关互动指标。该工作为工业级检索系统集成个性化多样性机制提供了实用经验。
key_points_zh: 在候选检索阶段引入用户级多样性约束，而非仅依赖排序阶段调整。
使用基于 Shannon entropy 的评分刻画个体多样性偏好，并据此对用户进行分桶。
在多来源候选检索中，为不同用户分桶设置个性化类别上限。
利用 Parameter Tuning Sequence 自动优化高维的分桶上限参数。
Facebook Marketplace 的大规模在线实验显示，PCap 显著提升浏览体验与互动指标。

llm_assessment.comment: PCap directly improves personalized product retrieval diversity in a large-scale marketplace and validates its value through online engagement gains.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: PCap直接提升大型电商市场中的个性化商品检索多样性，并通过在线实验验证了用户互动收益。
